name: Published Turtle System 2 BTC transfer audit
entry: Intraday one tick (0.1 USDT) beyond previous 55 complete UTC days
exit: Opposite previous 20 complete UTC days or individual 2N stop
N: 20 day mean TR seed, then (19*N+TR)/20; freeze at campaign entry
additions: 0.5 frozen N beyond previous actual slipped fill, maximum four units; move existing stops 0.5N per addition; new stop 2N from its own fill
scope_deviations: BTC perpetual alone, not original diversified commodity portfolio
Fixed campaign unit quantity: 0.25% of initial reference equity per N; no original annual subjective resizing or loss scaling
UTC cryptocurrency days and modeled exchange costs/funding
Frozen campaign N avoids undocumented mid-campaign weekly N changes
cost: 0.06% fee plus 0.02% adverse slippage each side; also double both
funding: Archived settlement rates with minute trade open as mark proxy; adverse debits only, favorable receipts ignored
execution: Both O-L-H-C and O-H-L-C minute paths, not asserted mathematical bounds; gaps fill at next observed open, tagged; no same-minute reentry after campaign exits
integrity: Previously frozen 27 five-minute quarantines; incomplete days excluded; 55 complete consecutive days required after each gap
period: 2023-01 through 2026-09, all already observed for other hypotheses; exploratory transfer check, not blind or prospective proof
report: Daily marked-to-market equity, yearly net return, drawdown, trade/campaign ledger, win fraction, concentration, holding time and data-gap effects
decision: No automatic deployment. Positive historical results alone cannot certify LBank manual entry profitability. Original long-horizon exits retained; no added TP1 or tight current-monitor stop cap.
parameter_search: None. Exactly one published system, two intraminute paths and base/double cost sensitivity. No choose-best path.
